name: aws-cost-audit
description: Work out where an AWS bill actually goes — down to the job, the cluster and the notebook that caused it — and write it up for whoever has to act on it. The Glue deep dive attributes DPU-hours to individual jobs and reconciles them against the bill, recovering runs from CloudTrail and CloudWatch Logs where jobs were deleted; the SageMaker deep dive attributes Studio spend to spaces, their owners and the notebooks that ran; the report skill turns a period of Cost Explorer data into a management-ready .docx with per-service root causes, recommendations by time horizon and clickable Cost Explorer evidence. Each ships a deidentified example of its own output. Standalone sweep scripts for idle and orphaned resources and S3 lifecycle gaps are included, plus a least-privilege IAM role. Every AWS call is read-only.
